evidence.quote: Michal Danielewicz Co-founder, Partner & Portfolio Manager Michal is co-founder of St. Petri Capital and Portfolio Manager of St. Petri L/S. Before founding the firm he was Partner and Chief Portfolio Manager at Nordea Investment Management (1998–2010), where he was instrumental in developing the thematic investment process and managed the Global Focus, North American and Technology equity portfolios. Michal holds an M.Sc. in Finance and Accounting from Copenhagen Business School.
